title: Event Production & Equipment Hire Melbourne | Sonido
description: Event production and equipment hire in Melbourne. Sound systems, DJ setups and full production for parties, pop-ups and private events. Enquire with Sonido.
introCopy: Planning a party, a pop-up or something of your own? Sonido does sound system hire, DJ equipment hire and full event production across Melbourne — from warehouse parties to private functions.
productionCopy: Tell us what you’re putting on. We’ll work through the space, the sound and the equipment your event needs.
Warehouse party, backyard, bar or venue — get in touch to discuss the scope of your event and the production support available.

cards.heading: Sound system hire
cards.copy: Share your space and expected crowd so we can discuss a suitable sound setup.

cards.heading: DJ equipment hire
cards.copy: Send through your DJ rider or the setup you have in mind.

cards.heading: Full event production
cards.copy: Let us know what else you need and we’ll confirm what’s available.

equipmentNote: Equipment availability and pricing are confirmed on enquiry.
enquireCopy: Send us your event date, venue, expected guest count and equipment requirements on Instagram.
formIntro: Fill this in and it comes straight to our inbox — no Instagram needed. The more you can tell us, the more useful our first reply will be.
formDetailsHint: Sound, DJ setup, lighting, full production — whatever you have in mind.
thanksCopy: Your enquiry has landed in our inbox. We'll come back to you with the detail — usually within a couple of days.
